title: In-Person Appointments Schedule of Deposits: How the Booking Deposit Is Worked Out
content:
The booking deposit on an In-Person Appointments visit is the visit type's self-pay booking deposit, rounded to the cent; none is owed where the visit type's self-pay booking deposit is 0.00 or where the figure worked out is zero or less.

The figure is worked out on the day the deposit is paid, in one order: the visit type's self-pay booking deposit is raised first; sums added to or taken off the booking deposit then apply to that product; and the booking deposit is rounded to the cent only at the end. The visit type's self-pay booking deposit is the figure published in the schedule of self-pay booking deposits.

### Outcomes

| Visit type's self-pay booking deposit | Figure worked out | Booking deposit owed |
|---|---|---|
| 0.00 | not worked out | None |
| Above 0.00 | Above zero | The figure, rounded to the cent |
| Above 0.00 | Zero or less | None |

### Worked figures (hypothetical visits)

- A New Patient Office Visit: self-pay booking deposit 125.00; the booking deposit is **$125.00**.
- An In-Office Procedure Visit: self-pay booking deposit 200.00; the booking deposit is **$200.00**.
- A Nurse Visit: self-pay booking deposit 0.00; **no** booking deposit is owed.

### Points of judgement

- Rounding happens once, on the final figure, never on an intermediate one.
- A figure that works out at zero or below means no deposit is owed; the deposit is never a negative amount.
